welcome_message:
Welcome to AgentOps Stacks v2 — a Databricks Asset Bundle template for production-ready AI projects.

This template generates the scaffold and CI/CD wiring for any AI solution. After init, develop your solution under src/ and use the agentops-stacks plugin (or your coding assistant) to apply evaluation, governance, and promotion patterns.

input_project_name.description: Project name. Used as the bundle name, default catalog suffix, and root directory name.
input_project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Project name must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (min 3 chars).

input_cloud.description: Cloud provider for the workspace. Determines CI/CD auth blocks.

success_message:
*** AgentOps Stacks v2 project created in '{{.input_root_dir}}' ***

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.input_root_dir}}
  2. Review .agentops-stacks/manifest.yml and databricks.yml
  3. Set workspace hosts and Unity Catalog grants (see docs/setup.md)
  4. uv sync  (generates uv.lock — commit it)
  5. databricks bundle validate -t dev
